title: What Context-Aware Spatial AI Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Context-aware spatial AI is artificial intelligence that understands the 3D world around it: where things are, what spaces mean, and how people move through them. It fuses cameras, depth, and maps into a live world model so devices act with awareness of place — not just pixels. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Context-Aware Spatial AI: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Context-Aware Spatial AI in one line: Context-aware spatial AI is artificial intelligence that understands the 3D world around it: where things are, what spaces mean, and how people move through them.
Why it matters: Devices that understand space can help in the physical world: guiding, assembling, navigating, and warning — instead of just showing information..
Where it is used: AR glasses, robotics, smart buildings, assistive navigation, industrial maintenance..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.
